part: Housing - single status window and rear screw access
check after removal: Check the one status opening and rear screw access. Inspect each post root.
Test the low diffuser stop and the shelf screw with the speaker installed.
Engage both concealed hooks and check seating, rear pilots and glass clearance.
Remove support from the accessible face and around the hinge. Inspect both ends of the crank pocket. Rotate fully with crank folded and extended.
Check collar retention and full-turn clearance.
Inspect the thin keeper and cycle the grip screw.
Check nut capture and grip screw alignment without forcing.
Check the KEY board remains seated and the plunger returns.
Check the bridge closes over dummy leads without imprints.
Slide into the receiver, lock and remove by hand. Inspect the dovetail for peeling.
Inspect the broad face and flange. Test the physical seat.

part: USB mask - rigid PLA fit gauge
check after removal: Flex the plate to lift the perimeter. Check mask outline and placement.

part: Service cover - rigid PLA fit gauge
check after removal: Check alignment without forcing the rigid cover into a flex fit.
Test maximum pack with dummy lead slack and connector. Remove before trying the other pack.
Test PCM, tail and lead exit in the alternative configuration. Use one gauge at a time.
Measure underside for sag. Seat at four controller mounts and verify screen position and pressure.
Check reel-wall lands and pin registration. Compare with real A2 when available.
Check bare board seats flat on the two integral rails. Remove before fitting the mated gauge.
Package side down. Inspect all three supports and both screw positions. Check display lift.
Install after keyed cap. Check switch orientation and alignment.

part: RGB carrier and emitter fit gauge
check after removal: Slide the carrier into the shelf; align the emitter to the one diffuser.

part: Speaker with gasket and lead exits
check after removal: Check oval rim, gasket height and lead exits. Inspect space under lamp shelf.
Check motor body, cable exit and board clearance.
Install in place of bare A3. Seat A1 and inspect plug space. Verify unlatching and extraction separately with a wired sample.
Cut the brim while supporting the hinge. Inspect the eye, then cycle the pivot by hand.
Check grip rotates freely and stays on its axle.
Insert from inside before the switch PCB. Check for twisting, binding and free return.
